preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1])
preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n and m, where 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 500.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n rows, each with exactly m non-negative integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) <= 1023 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is a non-negative integer between 0 and 1023 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NIE' if not any(all(0 <= int(c_j) - 1 < m for c_j in c) and (xor := functools.reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, [int(stdin.splitlines()[i].split()[int(c_j) - 1]) for i, c_j in enumerate(c)])) > 0 for c in itertools.product(*[range(1, m + 1) for _ in range(n)])) else stdout.strip() == 'TAK' and all(1 <= int(c_j) <= m for c_j in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) and (xor := functools.reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, [int(stdin.splitlines()[i].split()[int(c_j) - 1]) for i, c_j in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()[1].split())])) > 0
postconditions.description: If no valid selection exists (all possible XORs are zero), output 'NIE'. Otherwise, output 'TAK' followed by a valid selection of one column index per row (1-based) such that the XOR of the selected elements is strictly greater than zero.
